selection_criteria: Per language: large, actively maintained (pushed within days of selection), permissive license, primary-language share matching the target language per GitHub linguist, and complementary project shapes (library/tool plus application/framework/monorepo). Stars alone were not used. Every entry is pinned to an immutable commit SHA; a refresh requires review and must not silently change baselines.
redistribution: Sources are fetched into a local cache for evaluation only and are never redistributed as fixtures. All selected licenses permit local use.

repositories.name: tokio-rs/tokio
repositories.rationale: Workspace-of-crates async runtime; exercises Cargo workspaces, macros, and high fan-in.

repositories.name: BurntSushi/ripgrep
repositories.rationale: Single-binary CLI tool shape; complements tokio's library workspace shape.

repositories.name: laravel/framework
repositories.rationale: Large framework with deep namespace hierarchies and heavy magic-method surface; matches Chakra's Laravel enrichment path.

repositories.name: symfony/symfony
repositories.rationale: Monorepo of many components; exercises package boundaries and cross-component references.

repositories.name: microsoft/vscode
repositories.rationale: Very large product codebase; exercises project references, layered src structure, and high-degree symbols.

repositories.name: react/react
repositories.rationale: Monorepo of packages with mixed JS/Flow-era shapes and heavy test trees.

repositories.name: django/django
repositories.rationale: Large mature framework with deep package nesting and an extensive in-tree test suite.

repositories.name: apache/airflow
repositories.rationale: Very large application monorepo; exercises plugin/provider layout and generated boundaries.

repositories.name: spring-projects/spring-boot
repositories.rationale: Multi-module Maven/Gradle build; exercises module scopes and annotation-heavy code.

repositories.name: apache/kafka
repositories.rationale: Large Gradle project with generated sources and mixed Scala boundaries.

repositories.name: dotnet/runtime
repositories.rationale: Flagship large solution-of-projects layout; exercises csproj boundaries and high-degree references.

repositories.name: ohmyzsh/ohmyzsh
repositories.rationale: Many small scripts in plugin directories; exercises discovery and function graphs at scale.

repositories.name: nvm-sh/nvm
repositories.rationale: Single large entrypoint script plus test tree; complements ohmyzsh's many-small-files shape.

repositories.name: nlohmann/json
repositories.rationale: Header-heavy library; exercises template-heavy parsing and include graphs.

repositories.name: protocolbuffers/protobuf
repositories.rationale: Large mixed C++/generated-code tree; exercises generated/vendor boundaries.

repositories.name: terraform-aws-modules/terraform-aws-vpc
repositories.rationale: Canonical module shape with variables/outputs/locals reference graphs.

repositories.name: terraform-aws-modules/terraform-aws-eks
repositories.rationale: Larger module with nested submodules; exercises module composition and cross-file references.

repositories.name: chanzuckerberg/cztack
repositories.rationale: Machine-generated Terraform JSON modules (*.tf.json) alongside HCL; exercises the Terraform JSON adapter path (issue #86).

repositories.name: prometheus/prometheus
repositories.rationale: Large single-module application with heavy interface usage and test trees.

repositories.name: kubernetes/kubernetes
repositories.rationale: Very large staging-module monorepo; exercises vendor boundaries and extreme symbol counts.
